title: 🧭 Page Explorer for Business Central: everything a page hides, in plain sight
summary: Page Explorer is an AL extension that displays all fields and actions available on a Business Central page in a single window, showing their current values, descriptions, and tooltips. It uses the native Page Summary Provider codeunit to parse page metadata and helps users understand page structure and available options.
key_points: Displays fields with current values and descriptions, plus available actions with tooltips in a side-by-side interface
Built on Page Summary Provider codeunit and Page Action table 2000000143 included in Business Central
Provides a 'With Value Only' filter to show only populated fields and a debug view showing raw JSON
Extended via pageextensions that add a Page Explorer button to any page by passing the page ID and record SystemId
Includes pre-built extensions for Customer Card, Vendor Card, Item Card, and Sales Order pages

quotes.text: The pattern is always the same: a pageextension that adds the action in processing and passes the corresponding Page:: together with the record's SystemId.
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows the reusable pattern that makes the extension easily extensible to any page without duplicating core logic.
